_comment: A33 verbose-boot setting (briq-02b). DURABLE user state: installed under /etc/nuxel/boot/verbose-boot.json and NEVER overwritten by a package/rootfs update (the installer installs it with the 'keep' rule; nuxelctl and the Settings UI atomically replace it only on an explicit user change). Read by /usr/libexec/nuxel/nuxel-verbose-boot before nuxel-wl-fb.service starts.
effect: shows the Nuxel boot log on the glass (launcher boot-log overlay + /var/log/nuxel/boot-stage.log) and shortens the boot animation so the log is visible as early as possible; the default (false) keeps the full 192-frame 24 fps animation and its minimum-cycle handoff.

bixby_hold_override.requested_by: hold Bixby during the early boot stage
bixby_hold_override.capability: the early boot stage must publish bixby-hold-override=1 in /run/nuxel/boot-stage-capabilities
bixby_hold_override.reason: the installed early boot stage (initramfs in the BOOT partition, revision A23) does not read the Bixby key state and does not export it; enabling the one-time override needs a BOOT partition update, which this mission forbids (no flashing). The override is implemented in tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-boot-stage-verbose.sh and is marked NOT DEPLOYED.
